description: This file provides Windows-specific implementations for file operations in the libwebsockets library, including file opening, closing, seeking, reading, writing, and certificate/file management functions tailored for the Windows platform.

methods.name: int lws_plat_apply_FD_CLOEXEC(int n)
methods.description: Stub function, always returns 0 on Windows.

methods.name: lws_fop_fd_t _lws_plat_file_open(const struct lws_plat_file_ops * fops,const char * filename,const char * vpath,lws_fop_flags_t * flags)
methods.description: Opens a file with specified flags, using Windows API, and initializes the file object.

methods.name: int _lws_plat_file_close(lws_fop_fd_t * fop_fd)
methods.description: Closes an open file handle and frees associated resources.

methods.name: lws_fileofs_t _lws_plat_file_seek_cur(lws_fop_fd_t fop_fd,lws_fileofs_t offset)
methods.description: Adjusts file pointer for a file by a relative offset.

methods.name: int _lws_plat_file_read(lws_fop_fd_t fop_fd,lws_filepos_t * amount,uint8_t * buf,lws_filepos_t len)
methods.description: Reads data from an open file into buffer.

methods.name: int _lws_plat_file_write(lws_fop_fd_t fop_fd,lws_filepos_t * amount,uint8_t * buf,lws_filepos_t len)
methods.description: Writes data from buffer to an open file.

methods.name: int lws_plat_write_cert(struct lws_vhost * vhost,int is_key,int fd,void * buf,size_t len)
methods.description: Writes a certificate or key buffer to a file descriptor.

methods.name: int lws_plat_write_file(const char * filename,void * buf,size_t len)
methods.description: Creates or overwrites a file with given buffer data.

methods.name: int lws_plat_read_file(const char * filename,void * buf,size_t len)
methods.description: Reads data from file into buffer.

ctags.name: _lws_plat_file_open
ctags.signature: (const struct lws_plat_file_ops * fops,const char * filename,const char * vpath,lws_fop_flags_t * flags)

ctags.name: lws_plat_write_cert
ctags.pattern: /^lws_plat_write_cert(struct lws_vhost *vhost, int is_key, int fd, void *buf,$/
ctags.signature: (struct lws_vhost * vhost,int is_key,int fd,void * buf,size_t len)
